_comment: TextLite PX1000 C SIP responder. Import this file into Pterodactyl as an egg.
name: TextLite PX1000 C SIP
author: filip2cz@users.noreply.github.com
description: Answers SIP calls with command-generated PX1000 C audio using sip.c and encode.c.

config.startup: {"done":"SIP client started; waiting for incoming calls."}

installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
set -eu

apk add --no-cache bash build-base ca-certificates coreutils curl git linux-headers pkgconf python3

ESPEAK_ROOT=/mnt/server/espeak-runtime
mkdir -p "$ESPEAK_ROOT/etc/apk"
cp -R /etc/apk/keys "$ESPEAK_ROOT/etc/apk/"
cp /etc/apk/repositories "$ESPEAK_ROOT/etc/apk/repositories"
apk --root "$ESPEAK_ROOT" --initdb --no-scripts add --no-cache espeak-ng musl
if [ ! -x "$ESPEAK_ROOT/usr/bin/espeak-ng" ] ||
   [ ! -d "$ESPEAK_ROOT/usr/share/espeak-ng-data" ] ||
   ! ls "$ESPEAK_ROOT"/lib/ld-musl-*.so.1 >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "Could not prepare the bundled eSpeak NG runtime." >&2
    exit 1
fi
echo "Bundled eSpeak NG runtime installed."

WORKDIR="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf "$WORKDIR"' EXIT
SOURCE_DIR="$WORKDIR/source"
PJSIP_PREFIX="$WORKDIR/pjsip"
PJSIP_VERSION=2.16

git clone --depth 1 --branch "$SOURCE_BRANCH" "$SOURCE_REPOSITORY" "$SOURCE_DIR"
curl -fL --retry 3 \
    "https://github.com/pjsip/pjproject/archive/refs/tags/${PJSIP_VERSION}.tar.gz" \
    -o "$WORKDIR/pjproject.tar.gz"
bash "$SOURCE_DIR/.github/scripts/build_pjsip.sh" \
    --tarball "$WORKDIR/pjproject.tar.gz" \
    --prefix "$PJSIP_PREFIX" \
    --cc gcc \
    --cxx g++ \
    --cflags "-O2"

export PKG_CONFIG_PATH="$PJSIP_PREFIX/lib/pkgconfig"
export PJSIP_CFLAGS="$(pkg-config --static --cflags libpjproject)"
export PJSIP_LIBS="$(pkg-config --static --libs libpjproject | sed 's/-lstdc++//g')"
make -C "$SOURCE_DIR" CC='gcc -static' sip encode
install -m 0755 "$SOURCE_DIR/sip" /mnt/server/sip
install -m 0755 "$SOURCE_DIR/encode" /mnt/server/encode

cat > /mnt/server/start.sh <<'START_SCRIPT'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu

public_address="${SIP_PUBLIC_ADDRESS:-${SERVER_IP:-}}"
espeak_runtime="$HOME/espeak-runtime"
if [ -x "$espeak_runtime/usr/bin/espeak-ng" ]; then
    PATH="$HOME/espeak-bin:$PATH"
    ESPEAK_DATA_PATH="$espeak_runtime/usr/share/espeak-ng-data"
    export PATH ESPEAK_DATA_PATH
fi

set -- \
    --registrar "$SIP_REGISTRAR" \
    --identity "$SIP_IDENTITY" \
    --username "$SIP_USERNAME" \
    --command "$SIP_COMMAND" \
    --port "$SERVER_PORT" \
    --rtp-port "$SIP_RTP_PORT" \
    --bind "$SIP_BIND_ADDRESS" \
    --baud "$SIP_BAUD"

if [ -n "$public_address" ] && [ "$public_address" != "127.0.0.1" ]; then
    set -- "$@" --public-address "$public_address"
fi
if [ -n "${SIP_MARGIN:-}" ]; then
    set -- "$@" --margin "$SIP_MARGIN"
fi
if [ "${SIP_SPEAK:-0}" = "1" ]; then
    set -- "$@" --speak
fi
if [ -n "${SIP_LANG:-}" ]; then
    set -- "$@" --lang "$SIP_LANG"
fi
if [ -n "${SIP_GAP:-}" ]; then
    set -- "$@" --gap "$SIP_GAP"
fi

exec ./sip "$@"
START_SCRIPT
chmod 0755 /mnt/server/start.sh

mkdir -p /mnt/server/espeak-bin
cat > /mnt/server/espeak-bin/espeak-ng <<'ESPEAK_WRAPPER'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu

runtime="$HOME/espeak-runtime"
for loader in "$runtime"/lib/ld-musl-*.so.1; do
    if [ -x "$loader" ]; then
        export ESPEAK_DATA_PATH="$runtime/usr/share/espeak-ng-data"
        exec "$loader" --library-path "$runtime/usr/lib" \
            "$runtime/usr/bin/espeak-ng" "$@"
    fi
done

printf '%s\n' 'Bundled eSpeak NG musl loader was not found.' >&2
exit 127
ESPEAK_WRAPPER
chmod 0755 /mnt/server/espeak-bin/espeak-ng

variables.name: SIP Registrar URI
variables.description: SIP registrar URI, for example sip:pbx.example.net.

variables.name: SIP Account Identity
variables.description: SIP identity URI, for example sip:1001@pbx.example.net.

variables.name: SIP Authentication Username
variables.description: Digest-auth username for the SIP account.

variables.name: SIP Password
variables.description: Optional SIP digest-auth password. Passed to sip through the SIP_PASSWORD environment variable.

variables.name: Text Command
variables.description: Shell command whose standard output becomes the encoded message.

variables.name: Baud Rate
variables.description: PX modem rate used by the encoder.

variables.name: RTP Port
variables.description: Even UDP port used for RTP audio; RTCP uses the next port. Allocate both ports in Pterodactyl.

variables.name: Local Bind Address
variables.description: Local IPv4 address or interface name inside the container; normally leave at 0.0.0.0.

variables.name: Public IPv4 Address
variables.description: Public IPv4 address advertised in SIP and RTP SDP when the server is behind NAT; leave blank when not needed.

variables.name: Encoder Margin
variables.description: Optional PX margin byte from 0 to 127; blank uses the encoder default.

variables.name: Speak Message
variables.description: Speak the text before the modem transmission. eSpeak NG is bundled by the egg installer.

variables.name: Speech Language
variables.description: Optional eSpeak NG voice or language code, for example cs or en-us.

variables.name: Speech Gap
variables.description: Optional silence after speech, in seconds from 0 to 600.

variables.name: Source Repository
variables.description: Git repository containing textlite-px1000c source code; used during install/reinstall.

variables.name: Source Branch
variables.description: Git branch to build during install/reinstall.
